verdict: Maybe. FOMO pitched brewed iced tea on Shark Tank India Season 3 and got a deal. Real brewed iced tea tastes better than the syrupy versions, but ready-to-drink beverages face high shipping and shelf-space costs.
angle: Buyers are moving from sugary soft drinks to lower-sugar iced teas. Brewed iced tea has a short shelf life compared with carbonated drinks, which makes distribution harder. Cafés, offices and quick commerce in one city are the best starting points.
